queries.sql: WITH h AS (SELECT x->>'caller' caller,x->>'definition_md5' historical_md5 FROM public.lf_eventos l,jsonb_array_elements(l.payload->'sql_callers') x WHERE l.id=20161), live AS (SELECT n.nspname||'.'||p.proname caller,md5(p.prosrc) current_md5 FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace) SELECT count(*) total,count(*) FILTER(WHERE live.caller IS NULL) absent,count(*) FILTER(WHERE live.caller IS NOT NULL AND h.historical_md5=live.current_md5) comparator_true,count(*) FILTER(WHERE live.caller IS NOT NULL AND h.historical_md5<>live.current_md5) comparator_false FROM h LEFT JOIN live USING(caller);

WITH x AS (SELECT e.value j FROM public.lf_eventos l CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(l.payload->'sql_callers') e WHERE l.id=20161) SELECT count(*) total,count(DISTINCT j->>'caller') unique_callers,count(*) FILTER(WHERE nullif(j->>'definition_md5','') IS NULL) hash_null,count(*) FILTER(WHERE (j->>'definition_md5') ~ '^[0-9a-f]{32}$') hash_valid,count(*) FILTER(WHERE (j->>'definition_md5') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{32}$') hash_invalid FROM x;
